description: Validate an e-invoice (XRechnung UBL/CII, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, EN 16931) with the official KoSIT validator. Returns valid/invalid, the detected format, every error and warning with its rule code, and the exact corrected value for common calculation errors. Pass the XML as text in `xml`, or a PDF/XML file base64-encoded in `file_base64`. Max 5 MB.

file_base64.description: Alternative: the file (ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF or XML), base64-encoded.

france.description: Also check the French rules (BR-FR, XP Z12-012), reported as a separate `france` block. Automatic when the seller country is FR.

xml.description: The invoice XML (UBL or CII) as text.

name: validate_einvoice
title: Validate an e-invoice
